title: Halloween Night
author: Yi Shen
description: Original autumn Halloween night by Yi Shen, modeled with a Blender script.
changes: Repacked as a single GLB; textures limited to 1024px; geometry compressed/quantized with gltf-transform Meshopt without simplification; PNG textures compressed with lossless WebP; default camera embedded; preview rendered with MuTracer and denoised with OIDN standard. Sky, unlit moon and mist, OpenPBR metadata and light radii baked into the GLB; foliage merged per material.
